name: Australian Culinary Federation Junior Chef membership
summary: Discounted chef association membership for apprentice and student chefs and pastry chefs.
key: Junior Chef Member $44 + GST (also Junior Pastry Chef Member $44 + GST).
who: Apprentices or students in cookery or patisserie with apprenticeship papers or proof of enrolment
catches: The application form lists $49.50 for the Junior Chef category.

evidence.quote: Student ID, proof of enrollment, apprenticeship papers, qualification certificate less than 2 years old
